sections.heading: Modernise applications. Connect your enterprise.
sections.body:
Modernise applications, automate operations and connect every channel your customers use.

Digital transformation is the adoption of digital technologies by a corporation to improve business processes, customer value, and innovation.

sections.heading: Specialist services. Our own software. One transformation partner.
sections.body: From applications and cloud foundations to automated operations and connected customer journeys, bring your next stage of change together. Explore our six services and LINKFIELDS IP: Linkworks and testoriumz.

cards.title: App moderni­sation
cards.description:
Cloud, DevOps & microservices. Rethink legacy applications, strengthen delivery practices and design intuitive experiences for the people who use them.

**[Read more →](/services/digital-transformation/app-modernisation)**

**LINKFIELDS IP — Linkworks**

A composable enterprise application platform for complex business apps where packaged ERP or CRM does not fit.

cards.title: Automation & RPA
cards.description: UiPath, Blue Prism & AI workflows. Automate repetitive operations and connect people, software bots and business processes.

cards.title: Integration services
cards.description: APIs, Boomi & enterprise integration. Connect applications, data and workflows across cloud and on-premises environments.

cards.title: WhatsApp Business & omnichannel
cards.description: WhatsApp Business: Conversational service & commerce. Omnichannel: Connected journeys, every channel. Bring customer conversations and business workflows together.

cards.title: Quality engineering
cards.description:
Test automation & AI code assurance. Build quality into delivery with continuous testing and Linkfields’ own testoriumz quality engineering platform.

**[Read more →](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering)**

**LINKFIELDS IP — testoriumz**

A quality engineering platform for continuous testing: test management, low-code automation, root-cause analysis, dashboards and CI/CD integration. Replace a fragmented tool estate with one platform.

cards.title: Cloud services
cards.description: Consulting, migration, development, Kubernetes and infrastructure. Build and run the cloud foundations that support your digital transformation.

sections.heading: Persistently Innovative
sections.description: A technology partner that modernises, runs, analyses, secures and scales the enterprise, combining specialist services with our own software and reusable delivery IP. Headquartered in South Africa, delivering globally.

sections.heading: Constantly Innovating
sections.description: Our 18+ years in business have acquainted us to a diverse list of industries with different requirements. We have consistently proven our adaptability to all kinds of business models, irrespective of their industry.
